usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistics Estonia, IA021 consumer price index change over same month of previous year
inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 3.5% year on year in September 2026 (1.5% in August, 4.1% in December 2025); World Bank 2025 average 4.8%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; Estonian CPI averaged about 7.7% a year in 2021-2026 and 3.5% in Sep 2026
inflation_projection.note: Estonia shares the ECB 2% target but its prices keep converging towards richer euro members, so 3% is used for long-run planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Estonia uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% since 16 September 2026 (2.25% from June 2026), confirmed in the ECB FM dataset on 31 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Estonian banks, overnight deposits from households (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight deposits in Estonia, August 2026 (0.31% in July).

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/Eesti Pank MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (2.35% in August 2026); no separate 3-month term deposit rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Estonian banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year; 1-2 years paid 3.08% in August 2026.

dps_rate.note: Estonian banks sell regular monthly savings deposits (kogumishoius), but no average or official rate for them was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Estonian banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits; household overnight deposits paid 0.32%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Estonia figure.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No retail government savings bond sold to individuals was found on the Ministry of Finance site; Estonian T-bills and bonds are sold to institutional investors.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Estonia issues 6- and 12-month T-bills only (22 Sep 2026 auction: 6-month 2.910%, 12-month 3.209%, institutional investors only); no 3-month bill. Source: https://www.fin.ee/en/news/government-issues-eur-373-million-worth-treasury-bills

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Estonian government bond yield was found; Estonia has few bonds outstanding and the Ministry of Finance investor pages showed no yields.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes, Estonia
tbond_10y_rate.note: Monthly average for September 2026 (3.83% in August); Estonia has little long-term debt, so the ECB convergence indicator is based on a basket of long-term loans and is only indicative.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Estonia taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: Flat 22% personal income tax on all income of residents in 2026, including interest; resident individuals declare interest in the annual return (no final withholding), or can defer tax through an investment account.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists; interest on government bonds is ordinary income taxed at the flat 22%.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Tagatisfond (Estonian Guarantee Fund), depositor protection FAQ
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per depositor per credit institution, plus up to a further EUR 100,000 for six months for funds from property sales, redundancy, retirement and similar events.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Estonian banks, revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate, not a cap: average rate on household revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit, August 2026.

equity_return_low.sourceName: OMX Tallinn total return index 2,255 on 30 Oct 2026, up 19% in a year
equity_return_low.note: Low case: the small Tallinn market returns little more than safe deposits over a long period.

equity_return_base.sourceName: OMX Tallinn (Trading Economics); 1-year deposit 2.35% less 22% tax = 1.8%
equity_return_base.note: Base capped near the after-tax safe rate plus about 4 points because the Tallinn exchange is small and concentrated, even though its recent record is strong.

equity_return_high.sourceName: OMX Tallinn; long-run global equity returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified euro equity fund matching long-run global equity returns of about 7-8% in euros.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.35% (ECB MFI statistics), assuming rates fall, less 22% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: term deposit rates drift down towards 1.5% before the 22% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.35% less 22% tax = 1.8%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in longer term deposits after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Finantsinspektsioon and the Estonian Insurance Association do not publish an industry life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover (riskikindlustus / tähtajaline elukindlustus) is sold, but no published premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care for insured people is covered by the Estonian Health Insurance Fund (Tervisekassa) with small patient fees; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is a small, mostly employer-paid market; no published premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Statistics Estonia IA002 CPI, health: +2.6% in the year to Sep 2026, about 7.8% a year since Sep 2021
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices have risen faster than headline prices over five years (7.8% vs 7.7% a year incl. the 2022 spike); 5% is used as a long-run planning figure.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Statistics Estonia IA002 CPI, education services: -8.3% in the year to Sep 2026, about 3.0% a year since Sep 2021
goal_inflation_education.note: The latest fall reflects fee changes; over the long run education costs are assumed to rise about a point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: Statistics Estonia, RV045 life expectancy by sex and age
life_expectancy.note: Men 75.60, women 83.57 in 2025; World Bank 2024 figure 79.3.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: Statistics Estonia, RV045 life expectancy by sex and age

support_ratio.sourceName: Statistics Estonia, RV083 population projection to 2085 (baseline scenario)
support_ratio.note: People aged 15-64 divided by people 65+ in the official baseline projection (based on 1 January 2024 population); World Bank 2025 old-age dependency 34.6 gives 2.9.

retirement_age_default.note: Pension age reached 65 in 2026 (people born in 1961), same for men and women; from 2027 it follows life expectancy at 65: 65y1m in 2027, 65y3m in 2028, 65y4m in 2029. Old-age pension needs 15 years of qualifying service.

retirement_age_government.note: Estonian civil servants draw the general state pension; no separate statutory retirement age for government employees could be confirmed from a readable official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.35% (ECB MFI), assuming rates fall, less 22% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: term deposit rates drift lower.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.35% less 22% tax = 1.8%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer term deposits after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half safe fixed income at about 1.8-2.4% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: National pension EUR 414.10 a month (rate after the April 2026 indexation; page updated 15 October 2026); paid only to people without the 15 years of service needed for an old-age pension.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid from pension age to people who lack 15 years of pensionable service, have lived in Estonia for at least 5 years immediately before applying, and get no pension from another country; not income-tested.

gratuity_rule.note: No per-year gratuity: under the Employment Contracts Act an employer pays one month's average wage on redundancy, and the Unemployment Insurance Fund adds one or two months for 5-10 or 10+ years of service, which does not fit a days-per-year rule.

public_pension_scheme.note: State pension insurance (first pillar) funded from social tax; pensions are indexed every 1 April by 80% social-tax growth and 20% CPI growth and never cut. Pensions are taxed as income above the basic exemption at retirement age (EUR 776 a month). The funded second pillar is voluntary since 2021.

dps.note: Monthly savings deposits are offered by banks; no average rate published.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Only 6- and 12-month T-bills are issued, sold to institutional investors.

tbond_5y.note: Few government bonds outstanding; no regular 5-year line.

equity_fund.note: Retail funds widely available; an investment account (investeerimiskonto) defers the 22% tax on gains.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold.

centralBank.name: Eesti Pank
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.
